default_guidance: Upload documents through the secure message center in the EP Capital client portal. Never send account statements by regular email.

category_guidance.core_fixed_income: For bond accounts, accrued interest and pricing vendors cause most differences.
category_guidance.balanced: For balanced accounts, trades that haven't settled cause most short lived differences.

document_guidance.custodian statement for the missing peri: Send the full custodian statement for the period, every page, as a PDF downloaded from the custodian's website. The account number, the statement date, and the holdings list must be readable.

document_alternatives.default: If you don't have the document, your relationship manager can request it from the custodian with your written authorization.
document_alternatives.custodian statement for the missing peri: If you can't download the statement, ask the custodian to send it to EP Capital directly, or sign the authorization in the portal so operations can request it for you.

followup_settings.human_review_rule: If the statement can't be obtained, operations reconciles the account by hand with the custodian.

followup_rules.text: If you can't get {documents}, the custodian can send it to EP Capital directly, or you can sign the authorization in the portal for reconciliation {record_id}.
Please send {documents} for reconciliation {record_id} before the deadline, so the month end report isn't delayed.
Operations usually finishes a reconciliation within {processing_time} of having both sides.
Upload {documents} through the secure message center in the client portal. Please don't send it by regular email.
A PDF downloaded from the custodian's website works best. Screenshots often cut off holdings.

followup_fallback: I don't have a specific answer for that. Your relationship manager can help, or I can tell you what's on file for this reconciliation.
